column1: # SCANS.tsv - which scan each transcription was made from, and proof it is that scan.
# IDENTITY IS THE sha256, NOT THE PATH. Rename or reorganise ~/bibliotek freely:
#   `python3 scans.py verify` re-finds a moved file by size then hash and tells you where it went.
# scan paths are relative to ~/bibliotek. Each scan was cut with qpdf from a full journal-issue
# scan on the Internet Archive; fetch-scans.sh regenerates the cuts (a regenerated cut need not be
# byte-identical: check page count and page size, then `scans.py rehash`).
# witness: USABLE = the Internet Archive OCR layer serves ocrdiff for the PROSE. It cannot witness
# formulas; every formula is set and checked from the page image.
